licence_note: licences of the HELM and Open LLM Leaderboard data are not declared in the supplied material; the repository ships fetch scripts and SHA-256 checksums, not copies of the data

helm_mmlu.score: exact match (EM) in points, per subject; # eval per subject 100-1534 (min 100, max 1534)

open_llm_leaderboard_v2_headline.normalisation: the leaderboard's own normalised columns (main); raw accuracy columns as sensitivity

open_llm_leaderboard_v2_subtask.selection_rule: fixed before looking at the data: models of the main population that have a results directory; top 300 by Average plus 400 random from the rest (numpy seed 20261102); latest results_*.json per model; models lacking any of the 39 sub-tasks dropped
open_llm_leaderboard_v2_subtask.note: the dataset is about 1.2 GB in total (the supplied data description says 13.6 MB); only the selected files are fetched
